description: Billing on a Google Ads account. action get (default): the manager's monthly-invoicing payments accounts the account can be billed to, its billing setups and its account budgets, read live. action setup: bill the account to one of those payments accounts (paymentsAccountId) and propose an account budget (spendingLimit in the account currency, or none for no limit; budgetName, purchaseOrderNumber). Google's API cannot add a card: an account without monthly invoicing is billed in Google Ads itself. setup lets the account spend, so it needs confirm:true after the user agrees. Free.

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

paymentsAccountId.description: 16-digit payments account id from action get

purchaseOrderNumber.description: purchase order number on the invoice

spendingLimit.description: account budget limit in the account currency; omit for no limit

validateOnly.description: true = check the budget proposal only

name: google_ads_billing
title: Google Ads billing (monthly invoicing)
